title: Laguna Beach UAP data-collection mission

tellings.quote: we spent 5 days on a rooftop in Laguna Beach observing the sky,

plain: In 2021, Kevin Knuth, a scientist who once worked at NASA, says he and a team including Matthew Szydagis spent five days on a rooftop in Laguna Beach, California, watching the sky to collect data on UAP, unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs. Knuth tells Michels this as one of the people who took part, and links it to a work titled A Tear in the Sky. The point was to study the phenomenon with instruments instead of relying on eyewitness stories.
